"''Yes, of course. As you know, our blockade is perfectly legal, and we'd be happy to receive the ambassadors.|Maoi Madakor and Nute Gunray|audio=MadakorAndGunray.flac|}} '''Maoi Madakor''' was a [[human]] who served as a [[captain]] in the [[Judicial Forces]] during the [[Republic Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. Between [[40 BBY]] and [[34 BBY]], Madakor flew a [[Consular-class light cruiser|''Consular''-class space cruiser]] with her co-[[pilot]] [[Antidar Williams]] to the [[moon]] [[Veeros]] while transporting the [[Jedi]] [[Yoda]] and [[Vetna Mooncrest]] so that they could [[Mission to Veeros|investigate]] experiments taking place there. In [[32 BBY]], she piloted the [[cruiser]] ''[[Radiant VII]]'' with Williams to the [[Naboo system]] in order to deliver the Jedi [[ambassador]]s [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. The two Jedi aimed to negotiate an end to the [[Trade Federation]]'s [[Invasion of Naboo|blockade]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]]. Upon reaching the [[blockade]], Madakor landed the cruiser on the Federation [[flagship]], the ''[[Saak'ak]]'', so that the Jedi could meet with Federation [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray]]. After the Jedi disembarked the ''Radiant VII'', it was [[Escape from the Saak'ak|destroyed]] by a Federation [[Droid laser turret (Saak'ak)|droid laser turret]], [[Death|killing]] Madakor and Williams. ==Biography== ===Mission to Veeros=== {{Quote|Well… we're on the south side of the palace. Solar activity seems to be ''hiding'' our approach.''"
"''Excellent, ''Captain Madakor''. Now… ''lower'' the ship.|Maoi Madakor and Yoda|[[Jedi Knights 2|''Jedi Knights'' 2]]}} Maoi Madakor was a [[human]] who studied at the [[Judicial Academy]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] and went on to serve as an [[officer]] in the [[Judicial Forces]] of the [[Galactic Republic]], working together with the [[Republic Diplomatic Corps|Diplomatic Corps]] of the [[Galactic Senate]] and the [[Jedi Order]]'s [[Council of Reconciliation]]. Between [[40 BBY]] and [[34 BBY]],The events of [[Jedi Knights 2|''Jedi Knights'' 2]] take place between [[40 BBY]] and [[34 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:JediKnightsDate|here]]. Madakor and her co-[[pilot]] [[Antidar Williams]] transported the [[Jedi]] [[Yoda]] and [[Vetna Mooncrest]] on a [[Consular-class light cruiser|''Consular''-class space cruiser]] to the remote [[moon]] [[Veeros]] when they were [[Mission to Veeros|dispatched]] to investigate dark experiments reported to be happening there. [[File:MadakorWilliams-JediKnights2.png|thumb|right|300px|Williams and Madakor transported Yoda and Vetna Mooncrest to Veeros.]] The two pilots landed the [[cruiser]] at the [[Veeros palace|palace]] of [[Atha Prime]], the moon's leader and sole inhabitant. The Jedi disembarked but found nothing at the palace and so departed in the cruiser, although they suspected that the experiments they sought were being hidden from them. Several [[Standard hour|hours]] later they returned in the cruiser on the south side of the palace. In the cruiser's [[cockpit]], Madakor informed the Jedi that [[Star|solar]] activity was covering their approach, and Yoda ordered the two pilots to lower the ship closer to the moon's surface. Yoda and Mooncrest leapt out of the vessel and soon discovered a horde of [[xerexi]] that Prime had created, fighting them but failing to prevent Prime from escaping. Yoda and Mooncrest then returned to the cruiser and left Veeros as other Jedi eliminated the remaining xerexi there. ===Death above Naboo=== {{Quote|Captain.''"
"''Yes, sir.''"
"''Tell them we wish to board at once.|Qui-Gon Jinn and Maoi Madakor|audio=MadakorAndJinn.flac|}} [[File:Radiant_VII_Cockpit.png|thumb|left|300px|Maoi Madakor transported Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi to the Naboo system.]] Madakor became captain of the ''[[Radiant VII]]'', a ''Consular''-class space cruiser belonging to the Diplomatic Corps.[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2018)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'' (2018)]] In [[32 BBY]], the [[Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo|blockaded]] the planet [[Naboo]] over a [[Merchant|trade]] dispute. In response, Madakor was tasked with transporting the Jedi [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to the [[Naboo system]] so that they could negotiate an end to the [[blockade]] on behalf of Republic [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]]. Madakor piloted the ''Radiant VII'' alongside Williams, and, upon arriving in the Naboo [[Star system|system]], they headed toward the Trade Federation [[flagship]], the ''[[Saak'ak]]''. On Jinn's orders, Madakor contacted Federation [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray]] to let him know that they wished to board at once, and she then landed the cruiser within one of the Federation [[starship]]'s main [[hangar]] bays. After the Jedi left the vessel to begin negotiations, Madakor and Williams remained in the cockpit and awaited their return. [[File:Williams_and_Madakor.png|thumb|right|300px|Madakor's final order was to raise the shields, but it was too late to save her and Williams.]] After receiving orders from his master, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]], Gunray gave the command for the Republic [[ambassador]]s to be [[Death|killed]], and a [[Droid laser turret (Saak'ak)|droid laser turret]] descended from the ceiling of the hangar bay. Antidar spotted the [[Turret-droid|turret]] and warned Madakor, who began giving an order to raise the ''Radiant VII''{{'s}} [[Deflector shield|shields]], but before she could finish the order, the cruiser was destroyed, resulting in the instant deaths of both pilots. Jinn and Kenobi managed to avoid their would-be executioners and [[Escape from the Saak'ak|escaped]] the ''Saak'ak'', eventually aiding the [[Naboo (people)|people]] of Naboo in [[Battle of Naboo|defeating]] the Federation. ==Personality and traits== Maoi Madakor had [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and light skin. She stood 1.63 [[meter]]s tall. ==Equipment== Madakor was wearing a blue Judicial Forces [[Clothing|uniform]] at the [[time]] of her death and was unarmed. ==Behind the scenes== Maoi Madakor was portrayed by [[Bronagh Gallagher]] in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. All of the scenes taking place in the cockpit of the ''Radiant VII'' were filmed on [[September 8]], [[1997]].''[[Creating the Worlds of Star Wars: 365 Days]]'' In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character's name was first used in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''. In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the character first appeared in the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|novelization]] of ''The Phantom Menace'', which was written by [[Terry Brooks]] and released prior to the film.[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]] While her surname was first used on a card in the [[2001]] ''[[Coruscant Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]],{{CCG|set=Coruscant Limited|cardname=Captain Madakor}} Madakor's first name first appeared in the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 33|thirty-third issue]] of [[De Agostini]]'s ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' magazine,{{FactFile|33|REP 1-2|Republic Cruiser}} which was written by [[Iain Lowson]]{{LinkedIn|url=in/iainlowson|text=Iain Lowson|archivefile=File:IainLowson-LinkedIn.png}} and released around [[August 14]], [[2002]].{{FFdates|33}} In the original script for the film, Madakor's final line is not "Shields up!" but instead "No! Warn…," and in a rough cut of the film, it was recorded as "Warn the Jedi!"{{InsiderCite|68|Star Wars Q&A|''Star Wars'' Q&A}} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Maoi Madakor|imagecat=Images of Maoi Madakor}} *[[Jedi Knights 2|''Jedi Knights'' 2]] {{Flash}} *{{Film|I}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Star Wars: The Phantom Menace'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] *''[[Star Wars: The Prequel Trilogy – A Graphic Novel]]'' ==Sources== *{{SW|url=films/star-wars-episode-1-the-phantom-manace-story-gallery|text=''Star Wars: The Phantom Menace'' Story Gallery}} {{Po}} *{{SWE|technology|republicdiplomaticcruiser|Republic Cruiser}} {{Imo}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|29|Databank A-Z}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' {{1stID|Maoi Madakor}} *''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'' {{Po}} *[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2018)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'' (2018)]] *''[[Star Wars Complete Vehicles, New Edition]]'' *{{ShipsandVehiclesCite|18|Starships and Vehicles}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|The Heroes of Naboo and Other Characters of the Galaxy}} *{{Databank|naboo|Naboo}} {{Po}} *{{Databank|republic-cruiser|Republic Cruiser}} {{Imo}} ===Non-canon sources=== *[[Ultimate LEGO Star Wars|''Ultimate'' LEGO ''Star Wars'']] ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Maoi Madakor |ja=マオイ・マダカー |ka=მაოი მადაკორი |tr=Maoi Madakor |uk=Маої Мадакор }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Madakor, Maoi}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Judicial Forces officers]]
